headword: {表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう}

definitions.explanation: A formal document presented to praise an achievement or long service, typically read aloud at a ceremony before being handed over. Common in schools, workplaces, and local government.

examples.japanese: ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received a certificate of commendation from the principal.

examples.japanese: {式|しき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{上|あ}げた→読み上げる：04604_yomiageru⟧。
examples.english: At the ceremony, the mayor read the certificate of commendation aloud.

examples.japanese: {三十年|さんじゅうねん}⟦{勤|つと}めた→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{記念品|きねんひん}→記念品：03049_kinenhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}られた→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: My father, who worked there for thirty years, was presented with a certificate of commendation and a memento by the company.

notes:
⟦{表彰|ひょうしょう}→表彰：17400_hyoushou⟧ (public commendation) + ⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧ (written document).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧: to present a certificate
- {表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{授与|じゅよ}→授与：12900_juyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to confer a certificate (formal)
- {表彰状|ひょうしょうじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{上|あ}げる→読み上げる：04604_yomiageru⟧: to read the certificate aloud

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{賞状|しょうじょう}→賞状：30671_shoujou⟧: award certificate — for winning a contest or placing in a competition

- {修了証|しゅうりょうしょう}: certificate of completion — records finishing a course
